snippet.title: Log Drop - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The core is hungry. Feed it.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4915640/Log_Drop/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=storelaunch_sep2026&utm_content=trailer

Description:
Log Drop is a 2D physics automation game with one noble goal: get more logs into the earth's core than is physically reasonable.
Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Chaotic or orderly, the build is yours. Fling, funnel and dam up the logs, then let the whole load go at once. Buy new tools as you go, and upgrade the ones you come to rely on.
Campaign mode: every zone is its own puzzle, with its own objectives.
Sandbox mode: unrestricted tools, build whatever you want.

#indiegame #physics #automation #incremental #sandboxgame
